combined_definition: pool A/B channel error sums and observed counts, then divide and average channels
seed_aggregation: arithmetic mean of individual seed losses; never averaged forecasts

bootstrap.sampling: A/B stratified moving contiguous noncircular blocks; sample ceil(n/block) starts uniformly from 0..n-block inclusive; concatenate then truncate to n; preserve paired origin/channel/seed losses
bootstrap.combined: Add period bootstrap occurrence weights, then pool channel sums/counts
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile interval of paired mean-seed loss differences and relative changes; temporal resampling uncertainty, not independent domains
bootstrap.scope: paired temporal resampling conditional on selected seeds; no independent-domain claims
